_comment: Golden cases. Add a row here whenever a real listing comes out wrong, then fix the DATA (categories.json / packages.json) or the engine, never a one-off if/else. Use title+categoryPath to test the rule path, or an explicit 'profile' (item dims in inches, weight in oz) for items that normally need the LLM. 'weight' is the listing weight for ONE listing quantity (null = unknown). Expectations: kind (flexible = mailer, rigid = box), maxVolume (package l*w*h in cubic inches), nameMatches / nameNotMatches (regex on box name), maxPackageWeightOz. Expected values below are reasoned estimates from the QA matrix, not measured packages: replace them with real measurements as you collect them.
